scoring_justification: T1 recompute: checker extracts local maxima from submitted curves and compares peak radii to paper-reported gold within tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold peak radii for alpha and electron energy product curves
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'Two notable peaks ... at radius 3.8 µm and 38 µm' (alpha); 'The radius ... greatest electron energy product was determined to be 1.1 nm' (electron).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly taken from the paper's results section.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported optimal radii, authoritative for comparison.

outputs.description: Normalized alpha energy product vs. particle radius. The hidden checker will locate the two main peaks and compare the peak radii to reference values.
Normalized electron energy product vs. particle radius. The hidden checker will locate the maximum peak and compare its radius to a reference value.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the peak radii from these curves and compares them to hidden gold values with tolerances appropriate for numerical implementation differences.

steps.description: Recompute the two dominant peak radii from the alpha energy product curve and compare to paper gold within ±10% tolerance.
Recompute the global maximum radius from the electron energy product curve and compare to paper gold within ±20% tolerance.
